title: Catalog after an invalid resync
summary: DJDL's Catalog after a resync from commit 7c41d0e whose .pkey/schema fails validation: one danger callout names the commit and each error at its entry and line, says devices still get v9, and points at the repository; the two entries with errors are marked in the list and the open one shows its error at the field.
compare: The last published version keeps serving: the page title reads 'Catalog v9' and the callout says 'Devices still get v9' (admin-2-20, guide state 'invalid catalogs').
One danger callout above the editor, role=alert: the commit, the error count, what still serves, the fix (repository, then push or resync), each error with its entry and line. No toast.
Each entry with an error carries a danger glyph in the list (shape, not only colour); the open entry shows the error under the field it concerns, with the danger edge and the reason in words.
No Review or Publish: there is no draft; Resync is the only action, outlined.
Managed config yellow marks context only (rule, chip, nav); danger is red; nothing in the section accent reads as a warning.
